values.en:
Terminology for linear algebra. The Pointer opens the complete registration module. Native declaration names and full argument indices are preserved; named `english` styles extend, rather than replace, existing upstream defaults.

| Lean constant | Style | Display template |
|---|---|---|
| `Fulcrum.VectorSpace` | `default` | `#1 has a vector space structure over #0` |
| `Fulcrum.IsAdditiveInverse` | `default` | `#4 is an additive inverse of #5` |
| `Fulcrum.IsLinearRepresentation` | `default` | `#5 is a linear combination of the vector family #6` |
| `Fulcrum.IsLinearRelation` | `default` | `\sum_{i\in [#4]} #5(i)\,#6(i)=\mathbf{0}_{#1}` |
| `Fulcrum.NontrivialCoefficients` | `default` | `\exists i\in [#2],\;#3(i)\ne 0` |
| `Fulcrum.LinearlyDependent` | `default` | `The vector family #5 is linearly dependent in #1` |
| `Fulcrum.LinearlyIndependent` | `default` | `The vector family #5 is linearly independent in #1` |
| `Fulcrum.RepresentableByOthers` | `default` | `#5(#6) is a linear combination of the remaining family after deleting the entry at index #6` |
| `Fulcrum.UniqueRepresentation` | `default` | `The vector family #5 in #1 has unique coefficients for every representable vector` |
| `Fulcrum.Subfamily` | `default` | `The family #3 (length #2) is a subfamily of #4 (length #1)` |
| `Fulcrum.Contains` | `default` | `#3 occurs in the length-#1 family #2` |
| `Fulcrum.HasRepeat` | `default` | `The length-#1 family #2 has equal vectors at distinct indices` |
| `Fulcrum.VectorSpace.add_comm` | `default` | `Commutativity of addition` |
| `Fulcrum.VectorSpace.add_assoc` | `default` | `Associativity of addition` |
| `Fulcrum.VectorSpace.add_zero` | `default` | `Additive identity` |
| `Fulcrum.VectorSpace.exists_add_inverse` | `default` | `Existence of additive inverses` |
| `Fulcrum.VectorSpace.smul_smul` | `default` | `Associativity of scalar multiplication` |
| `Fulcrum.VectorSpace.smul_add` | `default` | `Distributivity over vector addition` |
| `Fulcrum.VectorSpace.add_smul` | `default` | `Distributivity over scalar addition` |
| `Fulcrum.VectorSpace.one_smul` | `default` | `Identity scalar action` |
